motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act, to consider: Clair-Maltby Secondary Plan - Ontario Land Tribunal Update 2024 Chief Administrative Officer Performance Objectives Section 239(2) (e) and (f) litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose; and Section 239(2)(b) and (d) of the Municipal Act, related to personal matters about an identifiable individual, including municipal or local board employees, and labour relations or employee negotiations.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act, to consider:
    • Clair-Maltby Secondary Plan - Ontario Land Tribunal Update
    • 2024 Chief Administrative Officer Performance Objectives

Section 239(2) (e) and (f) litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose; and

Section 239(2)(b) and (d) of the Municipal Act, related to personal matters about an identifiable individual, including municipal or local board employees, and labour relations or employee negotiations.

motions.text: That the 2024 Chief Administrative Officer performance objectives, as presented and discussed at the February 6, 2024, closed Committee of the Whole meeting, be approved and that the Chief Administrative Officer present a public presentation on their 2024 performance objectives at the February 6, 2024, Committee of the Whole meeting.
motions.text_html: 1. That the 2024 Chief Administrative Officer performance objectives, as presented and discussed at the February 6, 2024, closed Committee of the Whole meeting, be approved and that the Chief Administrative Officer present a public presentation on their 2024 performance objectives at the February 6, 2024, Committee of the Whole meeting.
motions.post_html: Scott Stewart, Chief Administrative Officer, presented on the 2024 Chief Administrative Officer Performance Objectives.

motions.item_title: Expansion of the Governance Section at Committee of the Whole - 2024-08
motions.text: That the Committee of the Whole Terms of Reference be revised to expand the mandate of the Governance section to include the Office of the CAO, as outlined in report 2024-08, dated February 6, 2024. That the City Clerk be directed to revise other governance policies and procedures which relate to the Governance section of the Committee of the Whole to reflect the changes outlined in report 2024-08, dated February 6, 2024.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Committee of the Whole Terms of Reference be revised to expand the mandate of the Governance section to include the Office of the CAO, as outlined in report 2024-08, dated February 6, 2024.
  2. That the City Clerk be directed to revise other governance policies and procedures which relate to the Governance section of the Committee of the Whole to reflect the changes outlined in report 2024-08, dated February 6, 2024.

motions.text: That the February 6, 2024 Committee of the Whole Consent Report identified below be adopted.
motions.text_html: That the February 6, 2024 Committee of the Whole Consent Report identified below be adopted.

motions.text_html: 1. That the Budget Impacts per Ontario Regulation 284-09 and Budget - Public Sector Accounting Standards Reconciliation for the 2024 budget be approved.

motions.text_html: 1. That the one-time contribution for physician recruitment as adopted in the 2024-2027 budget be transferred to the Guelph-Wellington Ontario Health Team without the receipt of the corresponding contribution from the Guelph Chamber of Commerce.

motions.item_title: Financial Plan for Water and Wastewater Services - 2024-34
motions.text: That City Council, as the owner of the Guelph Municipal Drinking Water System, approve the current six-year financial plan as required under Ontario Regulation 453/07 and the Municipal Drinking Water License.
motions.text_html: 1. That City Council, as the owner of the Guelph Municipal Drinking Water System, approve the current six-year financial plan as required under Ontario Regulation 453/07 and the Municipal Drinking Water License.

motions.text: That the Payment-in-lieu of Off-street Parking Policy effective March 1, 2024 attached as Attachment-1 to the report entitled “Payment-in-lieu of Off-street Parking Policy”, be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Payment-in-lieu of Off-street Parking Policy effective March 1, 2024 attached as Attachment-1 to the report entitled “Payment-in-lieu of Off-street Parking Policy”, be approved.

motions.text: That Schedule A of the Development Application Fee Bylaw be amended to include the “Estimated cost of a parking space” and the “Payment-in-lieu of Off-street Parking application fee”.
motions.text_html: 1. That Schedule A of the Development Application Fee Bylaw be amended to include the “Estimated cost of a parking space” and the “Payment-in-lieu of Off-street Parking application fee”.

motions.item_title: Wyndham Street North Cross Section and St George’s Square Intersection - 2024-37
motions.text: That Council direct staff to reconstruct the Wyndham Street North corridor as follows: Wyndham Street – Carden Street to Woolwich Street as one lane of traffic in each direction with parallel parking and separated unidirectional bike paths along both sides of the road with flexibility to accommodate the seasonal patio program; and, St. George’s Square as an offset intersection similar to existing conditions with operational improvements and separated unidirectional bike paths.
motions.text_html:
1. That Council direct staff to reconstruct the Wyndham Street North corridor as follows:
    1. Wyndham Street – Carden Street to Woolwich Street as one lane of traffic in each direction with parallel parking and separated unidirectional bike paths along both sides of the road with flexibility to accommodate the seasonal patio program; and,
    2. St. George’s Square as an offset intersection similar to existing conditions with operational improvements and separated unidirectional bike paths.

motions.text: That the meeting be adjourned. (5:22 p.m.)
